tenders.description: 1. The Comsats University Islamabad, Wah Campus (Works) has reserved Funds for the procurement planned for FY 2026-27. The Comsats University Islamabad, Wah Campus (Works) intends to apply part of the proceeds of this Fund to cover eligible payments under the contract for the " Procurement of UPS, Dry Batteries and Allied Accessories" with the reference of "P80602" 2. The Comsats University Islamabad, Wah Campus (Works) invites sealed Bids from eligible Bidders for procurement of goods described in the bidding documents on EPADS v2.0. 3. Single Stage-Two Envelope will be used by adopting Least Cost Based Selection (LCBS) Technique for the subject procurement, in line with the Public Procurement Rules, 2004 and any Regulations, Regulatory Guides, Procurement Guidelines or Instructions issued by the Authority from time to time. 4. All Bids must be accompanied by a Bid Security amounting described in Bid Security Section in Bidding Document in the form of Pay Order, Demand Draft or all bids must be accompanied by bid securing declaration in the format specified in the Bidding documents 5. E-Bidding documents, containing detailed terms & conditions, specifications and requirements etc. are available on e-Pak Acquisition and Disposal System (EPADS) at https://epads.gov.pk/opportunities/federal/procurements/80602 for all the interested bidders registered on EPADS v2.0. Bidders are required to get themselves registered on EPADS v2.0 to participate in Bidding process. 6. The e-bids, prepared in accordance with the instructions in the e-Bidding Documents, must be submitted through EPADS v2.0 on or before Tuesday, August 25, 2026 11:00 AM.
